name: Vignette
desc: Breathing darkroom vignette with a wandering center and drifting light-leak glows; edges close in on the beat while soft flares crawl across the frame.

darkness.doc: edge opacity / how dark the frame border gets

spread.doc: how far the darkness reaches inward (0 corners only, 1 near center)

tint.doc: how much the edge is hue-tinted vs pure black

style.doc: aesthetic: pure dark frame / inverted bright center halo / chromatic-aberration colored edge fringes (abstract) / warm burnt edges with rising embers

act.doc: multi-minute program: breathe steady, pulse hits hard on beats, iris slowly opens+closes over ~40s, drift roams the frame
